# Edinformatics

> A comprehensive K-12 STEM education platform offering interactive tutorials, 3D molecular visualizations, and hands-on science activities aligned with NGSS standards.

Edinformatics provides free educational resources for middle and high school students covering physics, chemistry, biology, and mathematics through interactive simulations, Jsmol 3D visualizations, and guided learning modules. The site emphasizes hands-on STEM activities and real-world applications of scientific principles.

## Key Topics

- STEM education
- K-12 resources
- Interactive simulations
- Chemistry basics
- Physics education
- Middle school science
- Jsmol 3D visualization
- MathMol
- States of matter
- Newton's Laws
- Molecular structure
- Online assessments
- Science activities
- NGSS standards
- Interactive learning

## Core Portal

- [Edinformatics -- Educational Resources](https://www.edinformatics.com): Main portal for K-12 STEM education with interactive simulations, assessments, and educational resources

## Physics & Mechanics

- [Work-Force - Energy - Power](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/force-work-energy.html): Physics lesson on Newton's Laws, work-energy, kinetic/potential energy
- [Electricity, Magnetism and Electromagnetism](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/electricity-magnetism-and-electromagnetism.html): Physics lesson on electricity, magnetism, Coulomb's Law, Ohm's Law
- [How is heat transferred? Conduction -- Convection -- Radiation](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/how_is_heat_transferred.htm): Physics tutorial on heat transfer mechanisms, thermal energy, temperature
- [Science of Fluids](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/science_of_fluids.htm): Fluid mechanics tutorial covering Pascal's, Archimedes, Bernoulli principles
- [About the Six Simple Machines](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/simple_machines): Physics guide on lever, pulley, inclined plane, wheel-axle, mechanical advantage
- [How does a battery work?](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/how_does_a_battery_work.htm): Science tutorial on lemon batteries, electrochemistry, electrical energy

## Chemistry & Molecular Science

- [Atoms -- Elements -- Molecules -- Compounds](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/atoms_elements_compounds.htm): Chemistry basics with Jsmol 3D visualization of atomic structure, bonding
- [Carbon Atoms and Molecules](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/c_module.htm): Interactive module on carbon chemistry, graphene, fullerenes, 3D modeling
- [What is the Difference Between a Physical and Chemical Change?](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/p_chem_change.htm): Chemistry lesson on physical vs chemical changes with assessment quiz
- [How many states of matter are there?](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/how-many-states-of-matter.html): Science lesson on states of matter: solid, liquid, gas, plasma, interactive
- [Solutions, Suspensions, Colloids](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/mixtures.htm): Chemistry tutorial on mixtures, solutions, suspensions, colloids, hydrocolloids
- [Why do metals conduct heat and electricity so well?](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/why_metals_conduct.htm): Chemistry lesson on metallic bonding, thermal/electrical conductivity

## Mathematics & Measurement

- [Mathematical Relationships in Science](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/mathematical-relationships/index.html): STEM lab guide on spring constant, pendulum motion, hands-on experiments
- [Scientific Notation](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/scientific-notation.html): Math tutorial on scientific notation with interactive conversion exercises
- [Mass Volume and Density](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/mass-volume-density.html): Interactive tutorial on mass, volume, density calculations for middle school
- [Basic and derived units](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/basic-and-derived-units.html): Reference on SI units, metric system, physical quantities, measurement standards

## Biology & Earth Science

- [What are the parts of the heart?](http://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/what-are-the-parts-of-the-heart.html): Biology lesson on heart anatomy, chambers, valves, circulatory system
- [Seismic waves and the layers of the earth](https://www.edinformatics.com/math_science/layers_of_earth.htm): Geology tutorial on seismic waves, Earth's interior, crust-mantle-core
